L'ICT Africa Summit 2026, l'un des plus: The ICT Africa Summit 2026, one of the continent's largest tech events, will be held from April 21 to 23, 2026, at the Palais des Expositions des Pins Maritimes (SAFEX) in Algiers, Algeria. This major event, dedicated to innovation, digital transformation, and an inclusive and sustainable digital ecosystem in Africa, will bring together tech companies, startups, investors, public decision-makers, and international experts.
Un programme riche en innovationLe somme: A program rich in innovation The summit will feature plenary conferences, panels led by global experts, technical workshops, innovative demonstrations, and a vast exhibition with over 200 exhibitors from 10 countries. Networking sessions, B2B meetings, and startup competitions will foster strategic partnerships, while thematic forums will address AI, cybersecurity, fintech, smart cities, Industry 4.0, HealthTech, Transport Tech, and EnergyTech.
Objectifs stratégiques pour l'Afrique nu: Strategic objectives for digital Africa Building on the success of previous editions, notably the 2025 edition which merged the Digital Africa Summit, ICT Maghreb, and ALVETIC, the event aims to accelerate African digital transformation, promote emerging technologies, and strengthen public-private synergies. With over 8,000 visitors expected, it positions Algiers as an essential pan-African digital hub and contributes to making Africa a major player in the global digital economy.
